cluster_sensitivity.caveat: Date + security - intersection score variance; not a calibrated small-sample significance test.

incidence.assumptions: Fixed finite-population randomized month/date and security draws; full response required. Actual planned monthly allocation, no iid CI and no stationarity claim.

month_date_crossed_security_resampling.limitations: 20 sampled date clusters; repeated securities reweighted globally. Illustrative month-stratified crossed-cluster range, not calibrated two-stage CI; serial dependence unresolved.

weight_definition: Derived batch-specific month/date inclusion probability; original frozen weights retained in event-level outputs
